name: Divine Devotion
source:
You awaken from a deep sleep and find yourself at the feet of five powerful gods. Why are you here? And what will they do with you?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你从沉睡中醒来，发现自己正躺在五位强大神祇的脚边。你为什么会在这里？他们又会如何处置你？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
